title: Dashboard
descriptionMe: Your performance on live calls and practice, and what to work on next.

gettingStarted.heading: Get set up in three steps
gettingStarted.subheading: Most people finish this in under five minutes.

createCopilot.title: Create your co-pilot
createCopilot.text: Start from a template: script, objections and goal in one click.

waitCopilot.title: Wait for a co-pilot
waitCopilot.text: An admin of this organisation sets up the co-pilots you'll use. Ask them if none is available yet.

practice.title: Rehearse with an AI prospect
practice.text: Talk out loud to a realistic prospect, with the co-pilot coaching you.

firstCall.title: Take your first assisted call
firstCall.text: Phone on speaker or an online meeting. Get suggestions live.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.empty: After a few analyzed calls you'll see what's improving and what needs attention here.

outcomes.title: Live call outcomes
outcomes.subtitle: Share of calls with a recorded outcome
outcomes.empty: Record outcomes at the end of live calls to link performance to results.

practiceProgress.title: Practice progress
practiceProgress.empty: No practice sessions in this period.

recommended.title: Recommended practice
recommended.subtitle: Scenarios built from your recent weak spots
recommended.empty: Recommendations appear after your first analyzed call. Meanwhile, try a ready-made scenario.

scoreTrend.title: Score trend
scoreTrend.subtitle: Every analyzed call, oldest to newest

skills.title: Skills
